jobs.title: Operational Excellence Manager (Last Mile)
jobs.description:
Rohlík Group is one of Europe’s fastest-growing online grocery platforms, changing how people eat and live. Founded in 2014 in the Czech Republic, we’ve grown into a trusted brand with more than one million customers across Czechia, Hungary, Austria, Germany, and Romania.

Our mission is simple to make everyday shopping faster, easier, and more sustainable. We combine smart technology, efficient logistics, and a genuine love for great food. From local bakeries and farmers to our own private labels, we make sure every product that reaches our customers is fresh, safe, and top-quality.

We’re committed to sustainability and supporting local communities, reducing packaging, and working closely with small producers. For our customers, Rohlik Group is more than just shopping, it's a better way to enjoy good food every day.




DEPARTMENT OVERVIEW

The Operational Excellence team drives continuous improvement, process standardization, and innovation across Last Mile operations. We support local teams in implementing group standards, solving systemic challenges in routing, loading, and delivery, and enabling sustainable growth as we scale.




ROLE OVERVIEW

As Operational Excellence Manager for Last Mile, you will own the design and delivery of a 3 to 6 month continuous improvement roadmap for last mile operations. You will lead adoption of group standards, embed best practices, and deliver sustainable improvements in delivery efficiency, cost per order, and on-time performance. You will partner with central and local stakeholders to find the real bottlenecks in the last mile flow, from route assignment and loading through to the delivery itself, and roll out scalable solutions across sites.




WHAT WE EXPECT FROM YOU

 - Owns the last mile improvement roadmap and makes sure initiatives are delivered on time.

 - Owns initiatives end to end, including group-wide projects: frames the problem, builds and defends the business case, runs the pilot, measures and evaluates the impact, and scales what works across sites.

 - Leads adoption of operational best practices in loading, routing, and delivery through coaching and influence.

 - Partners with group-level development and performance management teams and local site teams to coordinate projects and current performance.

 - Reads the problem in the real operation as well as in the data, tells the true cause apart from the noise, and turns the fix into a standard.

 - Documents processes (VSM, process maps).




WHAT WE LOOK FOR



Required

 - 5+ years of operational experience owning projects or programs in the last mile for retail.

 - Strong leadership and coaching capability.

 - Excellent communication and stakeholder management.

 - Analytical thinker who can define metrics, read data, and separate cause from correlation.

 - Project management experience.

 - Willingness to travel 2 to 3 days per week across sites.



Preferred

 - Background in e-commerce, grocery, or same-day delivery.

 - Six Sigma and/or project management certification.




WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU

 - Fair reward - You’ll get a strong fixed salary, no bonus games, no politics. Great work is rewarded clearly and fairly.

 - Good food every day - You’ll enjoy a free lunch every day and fresh fruit & veggies in the office. Because good food fuels great work.

 - Life, not just work - You’ll have real flexibility three days in the office, 2 days at the Home Office where it suits you. And unlimited paid vacation based on trust.

 - Personal growth - You’ll grow as fast as Rohlik does. Every challenge is a chance to learn and make an impact.

 - Real impact - What you do here matters. You’ll see your work changing how people eat and live from day one.

 - Recognition among colleagues - Your effort won’t go unnoticed. You can recognise others (and be recognised) through peer credits to use in our internal cafeteria.

 - Xtra membership - You’ll get free Xtra membership and 10% cashback on everything you buy on Rohlik

 - A team that sticks together - You’ll work with people who move fast, support each other and celebrate wins together.

 - If this sounds like you - You’re someone who takes ownership, acts fast and gets things done. Ready to bake something great with us?

#LI-ML1

jobs.title: Head of Finance Automation/ AI Agentification
jobs.description:
Finance at Rohlik is being rebuilt to run on AI. We already have agents in production that chase overdue payments, process invoices, allocate cash and clear the team's inbox. The pieces work. What we need now is one person to own the whole thing and make it deliver at scale.

 


ROLE OVERVIEW

This is a new role that owns how AI and automation reshape the finance operating model across the Group. You will take a programme that is already live across procure to pay, order to cash and our shared services centre, and turn it from a set of promising experiments into the way finance actually runs.

You report to the Group CFO. You inherit a small team and a live roadmap, and you own the result. You decide what gets automated first, you build and ship with AI tools when that is the fastest way, and you hold every workstream to a number.

The role is deliberately hands on. You should be close enough to the work to build an agent or connect two systems through an API with AI assistance, even though you are not a software developer. You should also be senior enough to redesign how finance works and bring the rest of the business with you.

 


WHY THIS ROLE IS EXCITING

 - You’ll inherit a live AI programme with real agents, real data and real impact from day one — not a greenfield slide deck.

 - You’ll shape how Finance actually runs across the Group as we move toward the next stage of growth — including the journey toward IPO readiness.

 - You’ll have access to a top-notch AI-first tech stack and the freedom to use it pragmatically.

 - You’ll work directly with the Group CFO, with fast decisions and no corporate red tape.

 - Your good ideas will be implemented almost immediately — not parked in a roadmap waiting for HQ approval.

 - You’ll lead a small team, but this is not a “manager from a distance” role. It’s highly hands-on, high-impact, and built for someone who wants to make things move fast.

 


WHAT WE EXPECT FROM YOU

 - Own the AI and automation agenda across finance, from strategy through delivery to measured impact.

 - Lead process redesign the right way: map and understand the as-is, then design an agentic-first to-be rather than automating the old steps.

 - Lead complex cross-functional programmes across Finance, Tech and Operations, driving delivery through stakeholders and teams beyond your direct reporting line.

 - Bring the live programme to its targets, with a clear owner, baseline and deadline behind every workstream.

 - Redesign core finance processes around AI and agents, starting with close, reporting and forecasting.

 - Build and ship yourself when it is faster, using AI assisted tools to create agents and connect systems such as NetSuite, Rossum and n8n.

 - Lead and grow the team (three today) and raise AI fluency across finance and the SSC so the business can use what you build.

 - Track what matters and report it straight: automation rate, close time, cash allocation speed, cost and effort taken out.

 - Roll out across our five markets, balancing local reality against one Group standard.

 


WHAT WE LOOK FOR

You have probably spent time in strategy consulting or in a transformation role, and you are now genuinely excited by what AI can do. You are a sharp generalist who can walk into a messy process, find the real problem, and fix it. You are as comfortable in a CFO pre-read as you are in the AI first tool building the thing.

 - A track record of leading transformation or automation programmes that actually delivered. A consulting, operations or generalist operator background all fit.

 - Strong understanding of finance processes, ideally gained through finance transformation, operating model redesign or automation programmes.

 - Hands on with AI. You can build agents and integrate APIs with AI assistance. You are not a software engineer and you do not need to be, but the tooling does not scare you.

 - You set baselines, name owners, hit deadlines, and say so early when something slips.

 - You can lead a small team and still do the work yourself.

 - You prioritise by impact and move fast. Better done than perfect.

 - You bring finance, tech and operations along with you.

 - Fluent in English. Czech is not required, but is an advantage.

 


WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU

 - Fair reward - You’ll get a strong fixed salary — no bonus games, no politics. Great work is rewarded clearly and fairly.

 - Good food every day - You’ll enjoy a free lunch every day and fresh fruit & veggies in the office. Because good food fuels great work.

 - Life, not just work - You’ll have real flexibility – three days in the office, 2 days Home Office where it suits you. And unlimited paid vacation based on trust.

 - Personal growth - You’ll grow as fast as Rohlik does. Every challenge is a chance to learn and make an impact.

 - Real impact - What you do here matters. You’ll see your work changing how people eat and live — from day one.

 - Recognition among colleagues - Your effort won’t go unnoticed. You can recognise others (and be recognised) through peer credits to use in our internal cafeteria.

 - Xtra membership - You’ll get free Xtra membership and 10% cashback on everything you buy on Rohlik.cz http://Rohlik.cz.

 - Sport & wellbeing - You’ll stay active with company sports challenges or a subsidised Multisport card.

 - A team that sticks together - You’ll work with people who move fast, support each other and celebrate wins together.

 - If this sounds like you…You’re someone who takes ownership, acts fast and gets things done. Ready to bake something great with us?

jobs.title: Last Mile Operations Manager
jobs.description:
AT ROHLIK, WE GROW FAST — AND THAT GROWTH ONLY WORKS WHEN OPERATIONS, PROCESSES AND PEOPLE MOVE TOGETHER. NOW WE'RE LAUNCHING A BRAND-NEW, HIGHLY AUTOMATED FULFILLMENT CENTER, AND THAT CREATES A RARE OPPORTUNITY: TO JOIN A SITE FROM THE VERY BEGINNING AND HELP SHAPE HOW IT WORKS FROM DAY ONE. WE'RE LOOKING FOR A LAST MILE OPERATIONS MANAGER WHO WILL LEAD THE LAST MILE TEAM, MANAGE A TEAM OF AREA MANAGERS TO DRIVE HIGH PERFORMANCE, AND HELP TURN A NEW BUILDING INTO A HIGH-PERFORMING OPERATION. THIS IS THE KIND OF ROLE WHERE YOU DON'T INHERIT YEARS OF LEGACY. YOU HELP BUILD THE SETUP, INFLUENCE THE STANDARDS, AND LEAVE A VISIBLE FOOTPRINT FROM THE START.



Why this role is exciting

 - You'll join at the launch of a new fulfillment center, which means real influence from day one.

 - You won't just maintain existing ways of working — you'll help build, shape and establish last mile processes from scratch.

 - A new site means new teams, new routing and delivery tech, new habits and a real chance to set the culture the right way from the beginning.

 - You'll work at the intersection of leadership, delivery performance, customer experience and continuous improvement.

 - You'll collaborate closely with cross-functional teams like Transport, OpEx, HR, IT, and Automation to solve live challenges.

 - This is a role for someone who thrives on startup energy, likes dynamic situations, visible impact and building something that will scale.

What you'll do

As Last Mile Operations Manager, you will lead the last mile operation, managing a small team of Leads to drive high performance across safety, delivery quality, and productivity.

You will:

Own last mile: Drive delivery performance, on-time rates, safety compliance, and labor management

 - Lead & develop: Coach, mentor and scale your team of Leads, ensuring optimal staffing, skills, and readiness

 - Work with cross-functional teams (Transport, OpEx, HR, IT, Automation) to solve live challenges and align resources

 - Monitor delivery KPIs, conduct root-cause analyses, and champion a continuous improvement culture

 - Support implementation of new processes, tools and routing/dispatch systems across last mile operations

 - Drive standardisation, safety compliance and best-practice adoption in a new operational environment

 - Support operations during peak periods, weekends and holidays with hands-on problem-solving

 - Build an environment with stronger standards, better processes and an engaging, high-energy culture from Day 1

 - Drive your team to successful outcomes and help them adopt new ways of working smoothly and consistently

What we're looking for

 - 3+ years of experience in last mile, logistics, warehouse operations, transport or delivery operations management

 - Proven track record of managing teams in fast-paced environments

 - Strong analytical mindset, data-driven decision-making and problem-solving approach

 - Excellent communication, coordination and leadership skills

 - Proficiency in English, and conversational-level Czech
   
   

Nice to have:

 - University degree or MBA in a related field

 - Experience with Lean, Six Sigma or continuous improvement methodologies

 - Experience with routing/dispatch systems, fleet management tools and high-volume delivery operations
   
   

What's in it for you

 - Fair reward – You'll get an attractive fixed salary, with no bonus games or politics. Great work deserves clear and fair recognition.

 - Good food every day – You can enjoy a free lunch every day, plus fresh fruit and vegetables at work. Because good food fuels good work.

 - Extra time off – We know rest matters. In addition to statutory vacation, you can also take extra paid time off by agreement, always with shift planning and operational needs in mind.

 - Xtra membership – You'll get free Xtra membership and 10% cashback on all purchases on Rohlik.cz http://Rohlik.cz.

 - Sport & wellbeing – Stay active through company sports challenges or a subsidised Multisport card.

 - A safe work environment – You'll work in a modern operation with the equipment and support you need to do your job well and safely.

 - A team that pulls together – Collaboration matters in last mile operations. You'll be part of a team where people support each other, keep the pace and handle daily operations together.

 - Work that matters – Thanks to your work, fresh food reaches thousands of customers on time. Every well-delivered change has a real impact on how the site performs.
   
   

#LI-FK1

jobs.title: Sales Director US
jobs.description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

Veloq is the software platform powering the next generation of grocery fulfilment. Born from Rohlik Group's proprietary technology and operational excellence across five European markets, we are now a standalone technology company empowering grocers to transform their warehouse operations and scale their same day e-grocery offering. Our modular platform spans automated picking, e-commerce fulfilment, and last-mile logistics and is built to power online grocery profitably.

Today, Rohlik Group serves 850,000+ customers across Europe using this technology. We have proven it works at scale. Now we are bringing it to the world. We’re only at the beginning of the journey. This is a chance to join a lean team and help build the operations engine, shape how we run and build the business, and scale a category-defining company from the ground up. You will have real ownership over your function, direct access to the CEO, and equity in a company at the beginning of a major growth curve.




ROLE OVERVIEW

You will own Veloq's commercial motion in United States. This is both a senior hunter role and a true people leadership role: you will lead the commercial function, manage the team, and build the next layer of sales capability as the business scales.

You will lead consultative technical sales of bespoke warehouse automation and software solutions, working closely with operations, IT, finance, and commercial stakeholders to shape customer-specific outcomes. You will develop and close high-value enterprise relationships, refine the sales playbook, and shape how Veloq sells to grocers and logistics operators in Europe.

We already have a clear ICP and an active set of target accounts in the pipeline. Your job is to take that foundation, deepen the pipeline, close the first major accounts, and build the next wave of enterprise revenue. You report directly to the CEO and will influence pricing, positioning, and commercial terms from day one.




WHAT WE EXPECT FROM YOU


1.  REVENUE & PIPELINE

 - Own the US revenue target for Veloq's warehouse automation SaaS — including closing the first enterprise account(s) and building the FY27 pipeline.

 - Progress and expand an existing set of qualified target accounts already in motion, while adding new enterprise opportunities in EMEA.

 - Build a qualified pipeline of enterprise accounts with a minimum 3:1 pipeline coverage ratio maintained at all times.

 - Develop a repeatable, scalable sales motion that can be handed off to future hires as the business grows.


2.  SALES MOTION & PLAYBOOK

 - Refine the US ICP: target verticals, buyer personas, account profiles, and deal stages.

 - Develop the sales narrative for each buyer persona — COO, VP Supply Chain, and CFO — anchored in warehouse economics, labour productivity, fulfilment cost per order, and same-day capability.

 - Translate complex technical capabilities into customer-specific value propositions, including tailored warehouse automation designs and implementation approaches.

 - Maintain deal discipline through consistent go-to-market engagement, account planning, proposal quality, and competitive positioning.


3.  ENTERPRISE RELATIONSHIPS & EVENTS

 - Build and manage relationships with enterprise retail and 3PL decision-makers across Europe.

 - Represent Veloq at relevant grocery, supply chain, and logistics forums to build brand presence and pipeline.

 - Develop strategic accounts into multi-FC, multi-year contracts.


4.  GTM & CROSS-FUNCTIONAL COLLABORATION

 - Work with the CEO on pricing strategy and major contract negotiations.

 - Collaborate with the Head of Partnerships on SI and co-sell opportunities.

 - Partner with product leadership on solution roadmap, competitive positioning, and market feedback — feeding buyer objections, competitive threats, and emerging trends back into the business.

 - Work cross-functionally with Operations, Legal, and Finance to ensure seamless handover from sale to implementation, reducing rework and improving customer satisfaction.


5.  LEADERSHIP & TALENT DEVELOPMENT

 - Coach, develop, and elevate the performance of the commercial team; set high standards for sales culture, activity discipline, and customer engagement.

 - Build succession plans and hire high-potential talent as the function scales — bringing in the right people at the right time.

 - Implement and uphold a consistent sales operating rhythm: pipeline reviews, deal qualification, forecast calls, and win/loss debriefs.

 - Optimise deployment of pre-sales, solution design, and business development resources across the account base.




WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR


MUST HAVE

 - 10+ years in enterprise SaaS or supply chain / logistics technology sales, with at least 5 years in senior commercial or hunter roles.

 - Proven closer with a track record of hitting or exceeding quotas at or above €1M ARR.

 - Experience selling into retail, grocery, or logistics operations at C-suite or VP level, with a strong understanding of warehouse automation and e-grocery economics.

 - Proven people management experience, including coaching, performance management, and building a high-performing sales culture.

 - Consultative technical sales experience: the ability to sell bespoke solutions requiring discovery, solution design, and alignment across operational and technical stakeholders.

 - Hunter mentality: you build your own pipeline and thrive using CRM and AI tools to accelerate outbound sales motion

 - Comfortable with long, complex sales cycles (6–18 months) across multiple stakeholders including operations, IT, finance, and legal.

 - Based in Prague, Berlin, or Vienna; fluent English.




NICE TO HAVE

 - Existing relationships with senior buyers at top US grocers or 3PLs.

 - Familiarity with CRM tools (Salesforce preferred) and pipeline forecasting disciplines.

 - Exposure to solution design, estimating, or pre-sales engineering teams.

 - Track record of building or formalising a sales playbook from scratch.

#Veloq #LI-ML1

jobs.title: Sales Director Europe
jobs.description:

Built on Rohlik Group’s (www.rohlik.group https://www.rohlik.group/) proprietary technology and operational excellence across five European markets, Veloq is now a standalone technology company helping grocers transform warehouse operations and scale same-day e-grocery profitably.

Our modular platform combines warehouse automation, e-commerce fulfilment and last-mile logistics into one system designed for real operational performance — not slideware. Rohlik Group already uses this technology at scale to serve 850,000+ customers across Europe. It works. Now we’re taking it to the market.

We’re still early in the journey. That means real ownership, direct access to the CEO, and the chance to help build a category-defining company from the ground up.

 

Why this role is exciting

 - You won’t inherit a big, layered sales machine. You’ll help build it.

 - You’ll sell a product that is already proven in real operations — not a concept.

 - You’ll work directly with the CEO and shape pricing, positioning and commercial strategy from day one.

 - You’ll lead Europe as a market, while helping define how Veloq sells globally in the future.

 - This role combines real enterprise hunting with true commercial leadership.

 - If you like startup energy, ownership and building things from scratch, this is exactly that kind of role.

 

What this role is about

You will own Veloq’s commercial motion in Europe.

We already have a defined ICP and an active pipeline. Your job is to deepen that pipeline, close the first major enterprise customers, and build a repeatable sales motion that can scale.

You’ll lead consultative sales of warehouse automation and software solutions, working with operations, IT, finance and commercial stakeholders to turn complex capabilities into customer-specific value.

Specifically, you will:

 - Own the EU revenue target and pipeline, with focus on closing the first major enterprise customers and building the next wave of growth

 - Take an existing set of qualified target accounts and deepen, expand and move them forward, while opening new enterprise opportunities across Europe

 - Build and maintain a strong pipeline with clear deal discipline, healthy coverage and realistic forecasting

 - Refine the sales playbook — from ICP and buyer personas to messaging, qualification and deal stages

 - Lead consultative sales of complex warehouse automation and software solutions, translating technical capabilities into clear business value for each customer

 - Build relationships with senior decision-makers across grocery, retail and 3PL — especially in operations, supply chain, finance and technology

 - Work closely with the CEO on pricing, commercial terms and major negotiations

 - Partner with Product, Partnerships, Operations, Legal and Finance to make sure deals are winnable, credible and smoothly handed over into implementation

 - Represent Veloq externally at relevant industry events and forums, helping build both brand presence and pipeline

 - Lead and develop the commercial team, setting high standards for execution, forecast discipline and customer engagement as the company scales

 

What we’re looking for

 - 10+ years in enterprise SaaS or supply chain / logistics technology sales

 - At least 5 years in senior commercial and/or hunter roles

 - Proven closer with a track record of hitting or exceeding quotas at €1M+ ARR level

 - Strong experience selling into retail, grocery or logistics operations at C-level / VP level

 - Strong understanding of warehouse automation and e-grocery economics

 - Proven people management experience — coaching, performance management, building strong sales culture

 - Consultative technical sales background — able to sell bespoke solutions with complex discovery and multi-stakeholder alignment

 - Strong hunter mentality — comfortable building your own pipeline and using CRM / AI tools to move faster

 - Comfortable with long and complex sales cycles (6–18 months)

 - Fluent English. Other languages will be an advantage

Nice to have

 - Existing relationships with senior buyers at top European grocers or 3PLs

 - Salesforce or similar CRM discipline

 - Exposure to pre-sales, solution design or estimating teams

 - Experience building a sales playbook from scratch

 

Why this is not a “corporate sales director” job

jobs.title: Sales Director Europe
jobs.description:
About Veloq: Veloq is the software platform powering the next generation of grocery fulfilment.

Built on Rohlik Group’s (www.rohlik.group https://www.rohlik.group/) proprietary technology and operational excellence across five European markets, Veloq is now a standalone technology company helping grocers transform warehouse operations and scale same-day e-grocery profitably.

Our modular platform combines warehouse automation, e-commerce fulfilment and last-mile logistics into one system designed for real operational performance — not slideware. Rohlik Group already uses this technology at scale to serve 850,000+ customers across Europe. It works. Now we’re taking it to the market.

We’re still early in the journey. That means real ownership, direct access to the CEO, and the chance to help build a category-defining company from the ground up.

 

Why this role is exciting

 - You won’t inherit a big, layered sales machine. You’ll help build it.

 - You’ll sell a product that is already proven in real operations — not a concept.

 - You’ll work directly with the CEO and shape pricing, positioning and commercial strategy from day one.

 - You’ll lead Europe as a market, while helping define how Veloq sells globally in the future.

 - This role combines real enterprise hunting with true commercial leadership.

 - If you like startup energy, ownership and building things from scratch, this is exactly that kind of role.

 

What this role is about

You will own Veloq’s commercial motion in Europe.

We already have a defined ICP and an active pipeline. Your job is to deepen that pipeline, close the first major enterprise customers, and build a repeatable sales motion that can scale.

You’ll lead consultative sales of warehouse automation and software solutions, working with operations, IT, finance and commercial stakeholders to turn complex capabilities into customer-specific value.

Specifically, you will:

 - Own the EU revenue target and pipeline, with focus on closing the first major enterprise customers and building the next wave of growth

 - Take an existing set of qualified target accounts and deepen, expand and move them forward, while opening new enterprise opportunities across Europe

 - Build and maintain a strong pipeline with clear deal discipline, healthy coverage and realistic forecasting

 - Refine the sales playbook — from ICP and buyer personas to messaging, qualification and deal stages

 - Lead consultative sales of complex warehouse automation and software solutions, translating technical capabilities into clear business value for each customer

 - Build relationships with senior decision-makers across grocery, retail and 3PL — especially in operations, supply chain, finance and technology

 - Work closely with the CEO on pricing, commercial terms and major negotiations

 - Partner with Product, Partnerships, Operations, Legal and Finance to make sure deals are winnable, credible and smoothly handed over into implementation

 - Represent Veloq externally at relevant industry events and forums, helping build both brand presence and pipeline

 - Lead and develop the commercial team, setting high standards for execution, forecast discipline and customer engagement as the company scales

 

What we’re looking for

 - 10+ years in enterprise SaaS or supply chain / logistics technology sales

 - At least 5 years in senior commercial and/or hunter roles

 - Proven closer with a track record of hitting or exceeding quotas at €1M+ ARR level

 - Strong experience selling into retail, grocery or logistics operations at C-level / VP level

 - Strong understanding of warehouse automation and e-grocery economics

 - Proven people management experience — coaching, performance management, building strong sales culture

 - Consultative technical sales background — able to sell bespoke solutions with complex discovery and multi-stakeholder alignment

 - Strong hunter mentality — comfortable building your own pipeline and using CRM / AI tools to move faster

 - Comfortable with long and complex sales cycles (6–18 months)

 - Fluent English. Other languages will be an advantage

Nice to have

 - Existing relationships with senior buyers at top European grocers or 3PLs

 - Salesforce or similar CRM discipline

 - Exposure to pre-sales, solution design or estimating teams

 - Experience building a sales playbook from scratch

 

Why this is not a “corporate sales director” job

 - You won’t step into a fully built organisation with fixed playbooks and polished processes.

 - You’ll join a lean team, work close to the founders and leadership, and help define how Veloq sells, grows and wins. That means ambiguity, speed, pressure — and a huge amount of ownership.

 - If that excites you more than it scares you, we should talk.

jobs.title: Head of Labour Procurement
jobs.description:
Labour is one of the largest cost areas across Rohlik Group, and external workforce services are critical to the daily performance of our fulfilment centres and warehouses.

As we continue to scale across Europe, we are establishing a dedicated Group Labour Procurement function to bring stronger commercial ownership, transparency and consistency to this strategically important category.

We are looking for a Head of Labour Procurement who will design and lead our Group-wide sourcing and commercial strategy for external workforce services across the Czech Republic, Germany, Austria, Hungary and Romania.

This is a build role, not an inherit role. You will create the category strategy, establish the commercial governance and introduce scalable, data-driven and AI-supported procurement processes across the Group.




WHY THIS ROLE IS EXCITING

 - You will take ownership of one of Rohlik Group’s largest and most business-critical spend categories.

 - You will build a new Group procurement function and shape how external workforce services are sourced and managed across five markets.

 - Your work will have a direct impact on operational continuity, cost efficiency and the performance of our fulfilment centres.

 - You will lead high-value tenders and negotiate directly with senior executives of staffing and workforce providers.

 - You will work at the intersection of Finance, Operations and HR, with significant visibility across Group and local leadership.

 - Rohlik is an AI-first company, giving you the opportunity to introduce automation, analytics and AI-supported tools across sourcing, contracting and supplier management.

 


WHAT WE EXPECT FROM YOU

 - Own and execute the Group’s procurement strategy for external workforce services supporting our fulfilment centres and warehouses across all markets.

 - Run tenders and lead negotiations at executive level; contract through the Group’s standard procurement and contract management tooling.

 - Own the commercial architecture and cost governance of the category: benchmark provider pricing across markets and sites, drive cost transparency, and deliver measurable savings against a spend baseline you establish.

 - Establish supplier performance management: service levels, quality, and delivery against contract, with regular scorecard reviews with providers and internal stakeholders.

 - Embed AI, digital procurement tools, and analytics to create full visibility of category spend and automate sourcing and contract lifecycle processes.

 - Monitor provider market trends, labour regulation, and pricing across CEE and DACH to future-proof the Group’s operations.

 


WHAT WE LOOK FOR

 - Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Law, or a related field; Master’s degree preferred.

 - 8–10+ years of experience in senior procurement, workforce/staffing, or category management roles — ideally with deep exposure to agency labour, temporary staffing, or outsourced services, from either the buying or the provider side.

 - Proven track record running large tenders and negotiating labour or service contracts at executive level.

 - Working knowledge of temporary agency work legislation and labour cost mechanics; comfort operating across CEE/DACH regulatory environments.

 - Strong commercial and analytical acumen — you think in unit cost, service levels, and total cost, not just contract value.

 - Strong command of AI and digital tools in procurement, including automation, analytics, and contract management systems.

 - Strategic mindset combined with a hands-on approach — you are comfortable building the function and its processes from the ground up.

 - Excellent stakeholder management: you will operate between Operations, HR, Finance, and provider executives, often with conflicting interests.

 - English language is reuired (C1+), Czech/Slovak will be an advantage.

 


WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU

 - Fair reward - You’ll get a strong fixed salary — no bonus games, no politics. Great work is rewarded clearly and fairly.

 - Good food every day - You’ll enjoy a free lunch every day and fresh fruit & veggies in the office. Because good food fuels great work.

 - Life, not just work - You’ll have real flexibility – three days in the office, 2 days Home Office where it suits you. And unlimited paid vacation based on trust.

 - Personal growth - You’ll grow as fast as Rohlik does. Every challenge is a chance to learn and make an impact.

 - Real impact - What you do here matters. You’ll see your work changing how people eat and live — from day one.

 - Recognition among colleagues - Your effort won’t go unnoticed. You can recognise others (and be recognised) through peer credits to use in our internal cafeteria.

 - Xtra membership - You’ll get free Xtra membership and 10% cashback on everything you buy on Rohlik.cz http://Rohlik.cz.

 - Sport & wellbeing - You’ll stay active with company sports challenges or a subsidised Multisport card.

 - A team that sticks together - You’ll work with people who move fast, support each other and celebrate wins together.

 - If this sounds like you…You’re someone who takes ownership, acts fast and gets things done. Ready to bake something great with us?

jobs.title: Category Manager Wine & Alcohol
jobs.description:
CATEGORY MANAGER – ALCOHOL & WINE

Location: Budapest, Jászberényi street



Department: Commercial / Category Management



Alcohol & Wine isn't just another aisle at Rohlik—it's a key growth driver, a destination for our customers, and a category where brand, quality, and commercial strategy intersect.

As Category Manager – Alcohol & Wine, you will own the commercial performance of this portfolio. You’ll be responsible for shaping the assortment, setting pricing and promotional strategies, and building high-impact partnerships with top beverage suppliers.

This is a hands-on commercial role where you will directly influence category revenue, margins, and the overall customer proposition. Working closely with the Senior Category Manager, you won't just manage existing lines—you’ll actively hunt for new trends, optimize supplier terms, and build a winning alcohol offering that keeps our customers coming back.




WHY THIS ROLE IS EXCITING

 - Direct commercial ownership: You will fully own the performance, sales, and margins of a high-visibility, high-volume category.

 - Build and elevate the offer: From mainstream staples to premium spirits and niche wines, you’ll shape what hundreds of thousands of customers see and buy every day.

 - Negotiation power and scope: You’ll lead commercial reviews, Joint Business Planning, and term negotiations directly with major FMCG and specialized alcohol suppliers.

 - Data-driven freedom: We move fast and operate without corporate bureaucracy—if the data supports a new trend, product launch, or strategy, you have the room to execute it.

 - Cross-functional impact: You’ll collaborate directly with Marketing on high-impact seasonal campaigns and partner with Supply Chain to ensure top-tier availability.
   
   


WHAT YOU WILL DO

 - Own category performance: Deliver on sales, margin, and profitability targets across assigned Alcohol & Wine categories.

 - Drive supplier management: Lead commercial negotiations, annual reviews, and Joint Business Planning to secure the best terms, innovations, and growth opportunities.

 - Optimize assortment & pricing: Continuously evaluate the product mix, pricing structures, and promotions to maintain a competitive and profitable customer offer.

 - Launch & innovate: Drive the end-to-end commercial evaluation and market launch for new products, seasonal activations, and brand expansions.

 - Analyze & act: Monitor market trends, competitor activity, and internal data to translate sales insights into concrete commercial actions.

 - Cross-functional alignment: Work with Marketing on promotional campaigns and partner with Supply Chain to optimize inventory levels and minimize out-of-stocks.
   
   


WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

 - Category expertise: At least 2–3 years of experience in Category Management, Buying, or Commercial Purchasing specifically within the Alcohol & Wine market.

 - Proven negotiation track record: Demonstrated success managing supplier relationships and driving commercial negotiations with major FMCG or beverage suppliers.

 - Strong commercial acumen: Deep understanding of margin optimization, pricing tactics, promotional strategy, and product life-cycle management.

 - Analytical mindset: Ability to navigate category data, draw clear conclusions, and make decisive, revenue-generating moves.

 - Communication & stakeholder management: Advanced English and fluent Hungarian, with the confidence to influence internal stakeholders and external partners alike.
   


WHAT WILL MAKE YOU STAND OUT

 - An established network within the local and international Alcohol & Wine supplier community.

 - Practical knowledge across diverse segments—from premium spirits and craft beers to private-label or mainstream wines.

 - Previous experience within e-commerce or fast-paced retail environments.
   
   
   
   
   WHAT WE OFFER
   
   - Fair pay – competitive fixed salary, no politics or hidden bonuses.
   
   - Good food every day – free fruit, snacks, coffee & soft drinks, plus Kifli Premium Membership with 10% cashback on every purchase.
   
   - Life, not just work – unlimited paid vacation to recharge when you need it.
   
   - Real growth – Kifli is growing fast, and so can you. Take ownership, learn, and make an impact every day.
   
   - Recognition & team spirit – your work is seen and appreciated; we celebrate together, from warehouse to HQ.
   
   - Dog Friendly Office
   
   - Movement & well-being – stay active with company challenges and use your SZÉP card for health, leisure, or food benefits.
   
   - Little extras – free parking, supportive colleagues, and a friendly, down-to-earth team culture.
     
     #Kifli

jobs.title: Senior Supply Chain Specialist
jobs.description:
At Rohlik, Supply Chain is where data, speed and execution come together.

We make sure products are available when customers want them, in the right quantity, with the right balance between freshness, cost and efficiency.

As we grow across multiple markets, supply chain becomes even more important — and more complex. That’s why we’re looking for a Senior Supply Chain Specialist who can take ownership at group level, work across countries, and drive improvements that go beyond one local portfolio.

 

Why this role is exciting

 - You’ll work on group-level supply chain topics, not just one local category.

 - You’ll own KPIs directly and drive actions that improve availability, waste, forecast accuracy and supplier performance.

 - You’ll lead strategic process changes that improve automation, consistency and scalability across countries.

 - You’ll work across different markets, supplier setups and demand patterns — giving you real international scope.

 - You’ll help shape how Rohlik supply chain operates as we scale further across Europe.

 

What you’ll do

As a Senior Supply Chain Specialist, you will own complex category portfolios and drive improvements across multiple supply chain domains at group level.

You will:

Own performance across markets

 - Own demand forecasting, replenishment and ordering across complex, high-volume categories

 - Take direct ownership of key KPIs — including availability, forecast accuracy, freshness and waste reduction

 - Drive actions based on performance, not just reporting or monitoring

Lead supplier performance and collaboration

 - Own supplier operational performance within your scope

 - Drive compliance to SLA metrics such as OTIF, shrink, ASN accuracy and lead times

 - Build improvement plans with key suppliers and push for better reliability

 - Work with EDI processes and electronic data exchange with suppliers as part of improving operational collaboration and data quality

Drive strategic process improvement

 - Lead process and system improvements that enhance automation, data visibility and decision-making

 - Support innovation in forecasting, replenishment automation and supplier collaboration tools

 - Drive changes that can be scaled across markets — not just local fixes

Work cross-functionally

 - Partner with Category, Operations, Finance and Tech teams to improve availability, inventory health and working capital

 - Work across markets to align standards, compare performance and escalate cross-market risks

 - Lead improvement projects end-to-end — from identifying the problem to implementation and measurement

Support team development

 - Share expertise with junior team members

 - Help raise the bar in process discipline, analytical thinking and supplier management

 

What we’re looking for

 - 4+ years of experience in supply chain, replenishment or inventory management, ideally in FMCG, retail or e-commerce

 - Experience working across multiple countries / markets

 - Strong track record in improving availability, reducing waste and increasing supplier reliability

 - Hands-on ownership mindset — you don’t just track KPIs, you improve them

 - Experience leading cross-functional process improvement initiatives with measurable outcomes

 - Strong analytical skills with advanced Excel, data modelling and BI tools

 - Experience with EDI processes (electronic data exchange with suppliers) — you understand how the system works, what key message types are used, and ideally have experience implementing or rolling out EDI processes in practice

 - Ability to operate independently in a fast-paced environment

 - Advanced English (written, spoken) is required

 - Fluent Czech or Slovak is required

 

What’s in it for you

 - Fair reward - You’ll get a strong fixed salary — no bonus games, no politics. Great work is rewarded clearly and fairly.

 - Good food every day - You’ll enjoy a free lunch every day and fresh fruit & veggies in the office. Because good food fuels great work.

 - Life, not just work - You’ll have real flexibility – three days in the office, 2 days Home Office where it suits you. And unlimited paid vacation based on trust.

 - Personal growth - You’ll grow as fast as Rohlik does. Every challenge is a chance to learn and make an impact.

 - Real impact - What you do here matters. You’ll see your work changing how people eat and live — from day one.

 - Recognition among colleagues - Your effort won’t go unnoticed. You can recognise others (and be recognised) through peer credits to use in our internal cafeteria.

 - Xtra membership - You’ll get free Xtra membership and 10% cashback on everything you buy on Rohlik.cz http://Rohlik.cz.
